verdict.rationale: The release notes describe batching same-shape micro-tasks into a single subagent dispatch, with batch reviews verifying every file in the brief made it into the diff, which supports bulk-style operations across many small tasks at once. However this is narrowly scoped to task dispatch within the SDD workflow rather than a general-purpose bulk-operation capability, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific feature. Missing for 10: evidence of bulk operations beyond task-dispatch batching (e.g., bulk file edits, bulk data processing), and community/hands-on validation of the batching feature's effectiveness.
